derivedFrom.context: Best view for Aurora/City, but operation is wind-dependent.

actionItem.en: Check wind status on official website before heading there. Buy tickets on-site or online.
actionItem.zh: 前往前在官网检查风力状况。可现场或在线购票。

names.zh: 特罗姆瑟港 (观鲸团出发点)

actionItem.en: Book months ahead for Nov-Jan dates. Prepare for seasickness.
actionItem.zh: 11月至1月的行程需提前数月预订。做好晕船准备。

names.zh: 特罗姆瑟地下隧道系统

derivedFrom.context: Complex underground tunnels with roundabouts. GPS signal often fails.

actionItem.en: Study the map beforehand. Know your exit number. Watch for roundabouts inside.
actionItem.zh: 提前研究地图。记住出口编号。注意隧道内的环岛。

derivedFrom.context: Sidewalks turn to solid ice in winter. Falls are common.

actionItem.en: Wear 'brodder' (spikes) on shoes at all times when walking in the city.
actionItem.zh: 在城市行走时，务必时刻在鞋上穿戴防滑冰爪。
